projects.title: Blinkey
projects.description: A facial recognition app that manages entry authorization. Movement and detection is sparked by blinking. The app utilizes a ML library called InsightFace in order to generate the embeddings of a user's face, by which we made a Python Backend to calculate and then store in a firebase database. The frontend was developed with Flutter, and included a ticket hub, connections to organizations, and a feature to update a user's face and credentials.

projects.title: UFC Predictor
projects.description: A ML model that predicts the outcome of UFC fights based on fighter statistics and match history prior to the fight. It starts by creating a fighter profile from their fight history prior (up to 6 fights) and then uses that profile against the other in order to generate a prediction (with probabilities). It also comes with a webscraper built to scrape fight data from a fighter off of UFCstats.com. It scrapes, formats, updates, checks if fighter is available for training, and checks what fighters are needed to be added to training data.

projects.title: Luminopolis
projects.description: A web application that consolidates Discord-like chatting for a classroom. It has features such as uploading slides, discussing said slides in the thread, and a text editor with live collaboration functionality.
